from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_csi300_csi500_relative_price_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'已有原源输出保持：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=readj(R+'/protocol_source.json')
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
plan=proto['fixed_future_model_plan'];names=plan['added_features'];eight=plan['features8_reused']
cols=['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx','close']+eight
d=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet',columns=cols)
assert np.array_equal(d.idx.to_numpy(),d.index.to_numpy())
q=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'data/raw/all_etf_momentum_v1r/fund_daily_checkpoints/510500_SH.parquet',columns=['ts_code','date','ts_close'])
assert q.ts_code.eq('510500.SH').all() and not q.date.duplicated().any()
q['date']=pd.to_datetime(q.date);q=q.sort_values('date')
assert np.isfinite(q.ts_close.to_numpy(float)).all() and (q.ts_close>0).all()
master=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/'data/raw/all_etf_momentum_v1/fund_master.parquet')
targets=master[master.ts_code.isin(['510300.SH','510500.SH'])].copy()
assert len(targets)==2 and targets.invest_type.eq('被动指数型').all() and targets.market.eq('E').all()
identity=targets.astype(object).where(pd.notna(targets),None).to_dict('records')
p500=q.set_index('date').ts_close.reindex(pd.DatetimeIndex(d.date)).to_numpy(float)
p300=d.close.to_numpy(float);s500=pd.Series(p500,index=d.index);s300=pd.Series(p300,index=d.index)
for name,h in zip(names,[5,20]):
 complete=s500.notna().rolling(h+1,min_periods=h+1).sum().eq(h+1)&s300.notna().rolling(h+1,min_periods=h+1).sum().eq(h+1)
 d[name]=((s300/s300.shift(h)-1)-(s500/s500.shift(h)-1)).where(complete).to_numpy()
d['相对定价来源可知时间']=pd.to_datetime(d.date).dt.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')+pd.Timedelta(hours=15)
beyond=d.date>pd.Timestamp('2025-12-31');d.loc[beyond,names]=np.nan
base=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv',usecols=['idx','date','era','n_train','max_label_exit_idx'])
pools=readj('reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json');pb={int(z['idx']):z for z in pools};assert len(base)==len(pb)==1212
used=set();unknown=[];support=[]
for z in base.itertuples(index=False):
 i=int(z.idx);ids=[int(a) for a in pb[i]['training_indices']]
 calc=d[(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&d.valid_features].idx.astype(int).tolist();assert ids==calc and len(ids)==int(z.n_train)>=252
 test=d.loc[[i]+ids];finite=np.isfinite(test[names].to_numpy(float)).all(axis=1)
 known=pd.to_datetime(test['相对定价来源可知时间'],utc=True).to_numpy()<=pd.to_datetime(test.decision_time,utc=True).to_numpy()
 complete=finite&known;used.update(test.idx.astype(int).tolist())
 unknown.extend([{'score_idx':i,'member_idx':int(a),'member_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[int(a)]).date()),'added_source_fields_complete':bool(f),'reconstructed_session_end_before_decision':bool(c)} for a,f,c,ok in zip(test.idx,finite,known,complete) if not ok])
 support.append({'idx':i,'date':z.date,'original_mature_rows':len(ids),'complete_current':bool(complete[0]),'complete_mature_rows':int(complete[1:].sum()),'all_original_members_kept':True,'full_added_fields_complete':bool(complete.all()),'reconstructed_close_before_original_decision':bool(known.all())})
needed=set()
for i in used:needed.update(range(i-20,i+1))
needed={i for i in needed if i>=0}
missing=[{'idx':i,'date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[i]).date())} for i in sorted(needed) if not np.isfinite(p500[i])]
assert len(used)==1711
save('两个ETF身份与原价格来源.json',{'at':now(),'fund_master_records':identity,'fixed_510500_raw_rows':len(q),'source_date_start':str(q.date.min().date()),'source_date_end':str(q.date.max().date()),'fixed_fields':names,'field_windows':[5,20],'unit':'价格变化率小数的差值','raw_prices_not_total_return':True,'510300_close_reused_from_original_control':True,'000905_SZ_stock_file_not_used':True,'historical_tracking_index_version_not_authenticated':True,'historical_price_first_receipts_authenticated':False,'source_clock':'RECONSTRUCTED_PUBLIC_SESSION_CLOSE_15_00_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_HISTORICAL_RECEIPT','price_distributions_and_rebalancing_not_pure_style_effect':True,'unknown_needed_510500_raw_dates':missing})
pd.DataFrame(support).to_csv(OUT/'全部1212日与原成熟成员支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
d.to_parquet(OUT/'原八字段与相对定价两字段_未读标签.parquet',index=False)
pd.DataFrame({'idx':d.idx,'date':d.date,'original_510300_close':p300,'original_510500_close':p500,**{n:d[n] for n in names}}).to_parquet(OUT/'两ETF原价与固定过去相对状态.parquet',index=False)
save('全部未知原成员.json',unknown)
passed=not unknown and not missing
gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E70','completed_at':now(),'status':'PASS_DIFFERENT_OBSERVATIONAL_ETF_RELATIVE_PRICE_ALL_ORIGINAL_MEMBERS_HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION_ONLY' if passed else 'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_MODEL_NOT_RUN',
'original_score_days':1212,'unique_current_and_mature_members':1711,'original_members_kept':True,'unknown_membership_records':len(unknown),'missing_needed_510500_raw_days':len(missing),
'first_used_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[min(used)]).date()),'last_used_date':str(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[max(used)]).date()),
'ETF_identity_authenticated_in_saved_master':True,'same_conditional_use_not_located_in_finite_prior_review':True,'clock_evidence_class':'HISTORICAL_PUBLIC_PRICE_CLOSE_RECONSTRUCTION_NOT_FIRST_RECEIPT_AUTHENTICATED',
'original_8_input_values_and_pool_identity_unchanged':True,'new_network_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False}
save('source_gate.json',gate);save('source_result.json',dict(gate,classification='PROGRESS_E70_DIFFERENT_PRICE_STRUCTURE_SOURCE_AND_ALL_ORIGINAL_MEMBERS'))
if passed:
 files=['两个ETF身份与原价格来源.json','全部1212日与原成熟成员支持.csv','原八字段与相对定价两字段_未读标签.parquet','两ETF原价与固定过去相对状态.parquet','source_gate.json','实际旧用途与两个ETF观察身份.json']
 model={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E71','registered_at':now(),'status':'REGISTERED_ONCE_FIXED_RELATIVE_PRICE_JOINT_SCORE_AFTER_FULL_SOURCE_BEFORE_NEW_LABEL_USE_OR_PREDICTION','source_experiment':'E70','source_gate':gate['status'],'source_protocol':R+'/protocol_source.json',
'source_stage_outputs':[{'path':R+'/'+f,'sha256':sha(OUT/f)} for f in files],'parents':proto['parents'],'fixed_model_plan':plan,
'planned_new_fits':2424,'controls':'原纠错八变量树/岭/同池均值只复用；不启用旧轮动、原就业或行业订单模型。',
'new_labels':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
'evidence_class':gate['clock_evidence_class'],'independent_validation':False,'only_executable_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],'observational_asset_only':'510500.SH'}
 save('protocol.json',model)
report=['# E70：两个ETF相对价格状态的旧用途与原全来源','',
'510300作为唯一风险执行标的，510500仅观察原价格相对结构。两当前基金主表身份匹配；000905.SZ股票文件未使用，不能把六位相同号码当CSI500指数。原半年规模比较及八因子/全ETF轮动都保持原用途与失败，本次原八五日条件用途不同；原历史已见，不是独立检验。','',
'固定过去5/20原交易日510300原价变化减510500原价变化，未复权、不含分红，并不等于纯规模/资金流/完整预期差。过去窗口全日历检查，缺价不填；原510300close与八字段只复用。收盘15:00在原16:00决定前属于公开价格的历史重构，不认证当年第一次收件或首版。','',
'源结果：'+json.dumps(gate,ensure_ascii=False)+'。','',
'全部原成员支持通过才另登记E71原504/252、深3叶60、岭10、5日原费标签、80分和两时期五门一次比较。来源通过不代表交易有效，账户必须另登记，0源码/网络/新标签/账户。','',
'[源协议](protocol_source.json)、[旧用途](实际旧用途与两个ETF观察身份.json)、[身份/原价](两个ETF身份与原价格来源.json)、[全源门](source_result.json)。']
(OUT/'相对定价_不同用途与原源支持.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
print(json.dumps(gate,ensure_ascii=False))
